No applicant-level complementos found.

notes: This is a business/management master that applies AI (strategy, data, machine learning, generative AI, sectoral applications, data governance) — RUCT places it under economics/business administration, so it is a path-X/AA hybrid rather than an AI engineering degree; record it as such. Along with 3500967 it is one of two brand-new UNIR AI titles in this batch, both verified in early 2026, so no cohort has yet completed and no accreditation renewal exists at title level — worth knowing before ranking. www.unir.net is Cloudflare-blocked (403 confirmed this session, WebFetch and curl with browser UA); guessed static.unir.net brochure paths for this title returned 404.
